## Sketchy 1.2.3
- Added image paste and drag-and-drop support, making it easier to bring visual references directly onto the canvas. - Improved pasted image previews and placement behavior. - Added clearer edge cues for opening drawing history and starting a new drawing. - Made edge cues feel calmer and more responsive by fading them based on pointer proximity. - Made the history sidebar easier to open with a left-edge click and less likely to close unexpectedly. - Improved multi-window behavior: new windows now start with a blank drawing, and drawing history stays in sync across windows. - Moved the pin control into the window chrome and aligned it with the native window controls. - Rounded and lowered the bottom toolbar for a cleaner canvas layout. - Refined freehand drawing so fast strokes preserve more input detail and curve peaks. - Updated keyboard shortcuts for creating drawings and opening new windows. - Refreshed the color palette with a purple final swatch.
